2608.12246.title: VICBench: A Multi-Language Benchmark for Code Vulnerability Detection
2608.12246.paper_summary: Evaluating security vulnerability detection tools requires benchmark datasets with vulnerability-inducing commits (VICs) - the commits that first introduce vulnerabilities into codebases. VICs are essential for determining the full range of vulnerable software versions. Existing vulnerability datasets suffer from limited programming language coverage, restricted patch complexity, and narrow project scope. Through our dual annotation by human experts and an agentic workflow, we create a benchmark - VICBench - of 100 verified VICs for 100 CVEs across 88 projects in Python, Java, and C++, covering 48 CWE types. VICBench features complex real-world vulnerability fixes averaging 38.6 lines and corresponding VICs of 252.5 lines - significantly larger than prior work. Our evaluation shows that state-of-the-art algorithms V-SZZ and LLM4SZZ achieve only 33.3%-40.1% F1, confirming that using existing approaches still entails significant manual effort. VICBench enables robust evaluation of vulnerability detection approaches.
2608.12246.paper_summary_zh: 評估安全漏洞檢測工具需要具有漏洞誘發提交（VICs）的基準數據集——這些提交首次將漏洞引入代碼庫。VICs 對於確定易受攻擊的軟體版本範圍至關重要。現有的漏洞數據集在編程語言覆蓋範圍、修補複雜性和項目範圍上都存在限制。通過我們由人類專家和代理工作流程進行的雙重標註，我們創建了一個基準——VICBench——涵蓋 88 個項目中的 100 個經過驗證的 VICs，對應 100 個 CVE，涉及 Python、Java 和 C++，涵蓋 48 種 CWE 類型。VICBench 的特點是複雜的現實世界漏洞修復，平均為 38.6 行，對應的 VICs 平均為 252.5 行——這比以往的工作大得多。我們的評估顯示，最先進的算法 V-SZZ 和 LLM4SZZ 僅達到 33.3%-40.1% 的 F1，確認使用現有方法仍然需要大量的手動努力。VICBench 使漏洞檢測方法的穩健評估成為可能。
